[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommends traditional Korean side dishes to complement BBQ beef, including:

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Kongnamul Muchim: Bean sprout salad seasoned with garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Gyeran-mari: Korean-style rolled omelette made with eggs and vegetables.  
[PREFERENCE] User decides to go with kimchi and bokkeumbap as side dishes.
